title: Personal Checking: refunding an overdraft item fee charged in error
content:
## Scope

This rule decides the refund of the most recently posted overdraft item fee on a Personal Checking account once its bank-error grounds have been judged.

## Formal clauses

1. **Grounds.** The fee is a bank error when a transfer from the linked savings account would have paid the item, judged on the account's current overdraft link and balance, or when the item's amount is the tier's per-item de minimis amount or less. Either ground alone suffices.
2. **Never twice.** A fee that already has a refund entry is never refunded again.
3. **Refund owed.** When the fee is a bank error and has no refund yet, it is refunded in full, never in part, at that fee's own amount, as a bank-error refund.
4. **Otherwise nothing.** Otherwise this review refunds nothing, and a goodwill request is decided under the courtesy gates of the general Personal Checking fee refund rules.
5. **No rounding.** Fee amounts carry 2 decimal places, so the refund needs no rounding.

## Truth table

| Linked savings would have paid the item | Item at or below the de minimis amount | Fee already has a refund entry | This review |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | No | Refund the fee's own amount in full |
| No | Yes | No | Refund the fee's own amount in full |
| Yes | Yes | No | Refund the fee's own amount in full, once |
| No | No | No | Nothing; a goodwill request goes to the courtesy gates |
| Any | Any | Yes | Nothing |

## Witness case (hypothetical figures)

The reviewed overdraft item fee posted at 27.50 USD on an item that the linked savings account would have paid, and it has no refund yet. The refund is 27.50 USD, the fee's own amount in full. It is not reduced to a part of the fee, and it is not replaced by a transfer amount or by the item's amount.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "a fee that is not a bank error can still be refunded under this review as a goodwill gesture". **Correct basis:** this review then refunds nothing; a goodwill request is decided under the courtesy gates of the general fee refund rules.
